parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a canonical sample-app location that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app boolean value. The production copy in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package: DebugPanel) is the authoritative implementation; the WallpaperSampleApp copy is a demonstration fixture that intentionally mirrors it. Consolidating the two would couple the production DebugPanel package to sample-app semantics, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent. The correct resolution, if the duplication is unwanted, is to have the sample app import and call the DebugPanel implementation directly — not to extract shared code.
